Watermark Adder

Add a customizable text watermark to any photo — choose position, opacity, size, color and angle, preview live, then download.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload your photo.
  2. Type your watermark text and pick a position.
  3. Adjust opacity, font size, color and angle (or enable tiling).
  4. Preview live, then download the watermarked PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where can the watermark be placed?

Nine anchor positions (corners, edges, center) plus fine-tune offsets. Drag-and-drop is not needed — the grid covers the common cases.

Can I rotate or repeat the watermark?

Yes — the angle slider rotates the watermark from -90° to 90°, and the tile option repeats it across the whole image for stronger protection.

What makes a watermark hard to remove?

A diagonal tiled watermark at low opacity is the hardest to remove. Corners at high opacity also work well.

Is my image uploaded?

No — the watermark is drawn and saved locally in your browser.
